incidents.name: ApeCoin airdrop claim without ownership snapshot
incidents.lossOther: 60,564 APE claimed with flash-loaned BAYC NFTs
incidents.notes: The ApeCoin airdrop contract paid out against current BAYC/MAYC ownership instead of a pre-announced snapshot, so the attacker flash-loaned five BAYC out of the NFTX vault, claimed 60,564 APE for them and returned the NFTs in the same transaction.

sources.ref: onchain review: airdrop contract 0x025C6da5BD0e6A5dd1350fda9e3B6a614B205a1F created 2022-03-17T11:50:36Z by 0x295d587aa3ca6e57e227a4430ab7c4c00989a195, unrelated to the attack sender; no EIP-1967 events, age from deployment - the claim was drained 1,358 seconds (22.6 minutes) after the contract went live. Loss is denominated in APE itself, whose price on its own launch day is not a reliable deep-market reference, so lossUsd is left null; contemporaneous quotes put 60,564 APE well above $500,000.
